feed.title: Awesome DSH Plugin — Curated DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugin List

entry.title: lancecheney/dsh-deepseek-balance
entry.summary: A real-time billing badge left of the Session log button: balance, per-conversation spend, peak/off-peak/flat pricing, auto-switching by model/currency/effort, daily official pricing fetch.

entry.title: BeiZi6/dsh-opencodego-usage
entry.summary: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.

entry.title: Lanxing6480/dsh-galgame
entry.summary: A visual-novel presentation layer for the DSH Web chat view: portrait diffs, streaming thought bubble, typewriter dialogue, and GalGame-style question/approval panels; switch back to the normal chat anytime.

entry.title: BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin
entry.summary: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.

entry.title: zhtx2024/dsh-skin-switcher
entry.summary: Adds a Skins page to Settings that auto-discovers installed skins for one-click switching, with one-click restore to the official default look.

entry.title: flyingtimes/dsh-trajectory-reader
entry.summary: Trajectory interpretation tab: summarizes each user round — what was wanted and how the assistant fulfilled it (needs/thinking/execution/results) via a rules engine plus optional LLM narrative; files, commands and errors at a glance; user messages stay verbatim.

entry.title: Gumiho12345/dsh-plugin-net-access
entry.summary: Net Access permission mode: keeps workspace-write protection while making curl.exe HTTPS work inside the sandbox (Windows).

entry.title: xiehuan123/coding-coach
entry.summary: Coding Coach: a 35-skill bundle plus a full agent preset for non-developers (8-stage product→launch pipeline with engineering/product/UI skills), installable via npm (`dsh plugin add coding-coach`) and as a Claude Code plugin.

entry.title: xiehuan123/dsh-deepread
entry.summary: DeepRead: deep-reading assistant with four modes (incl. a claim-evidence-data-relations knowledge map with four confidence levels), WeChat article links / local .pdf (built-in pure-JS extractor) / pasted text, and optional MD / FreeMind / styled HTML export.

entry.title: beancookie/dsh-plugin-anydoc
entry.summary: Registers @firecrawl/anydoc as an `anydoc` tool for the Agent, converting Word/PPT/Excel/PDF/EPUB and other document formats into GitHub-Flavored Markdown.

entry.title: xmutfyh/dsh-plugin-writing-guard
entry.summary: Academic writing guard: local-regex linter for revision-process residue, defensive writing and AI-writing tells (em-dash abuse, not-X-but-Y, LLM word spikes, rule of three), with incremental auto-audit on paper file writes (writing_audit + writing_rules).

entry.title: lsjspl/dsh-plugin-grok2api-media-tool
entry.summary: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.

entry.title: dhicoc/dsh-reverse-skill
entry.summary: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md files) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: a skill router for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research.

entry.title: 940842546/dsh-usage-billing
entry.summary: Usage and cost statistics with peak/off-peak pricing after the 2026-08-17 rate change, a floating summary panel, per-session breakdowns, and a usage heatmap.

entry.title: CH4ACKO3/dsh-harmony
entry.summary: Lets one DSH plugin modify another plugin's code at runtime, with Patch ordering, conflict checks, and hot reload.

entry.title: zealot00/dsh-pet
entry.summary: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.

entry.title: openma-ai/deepseek-harness-tui
entry.summary: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.

entry.title: asukasec/dsh-message-preview
entry.summary: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.

entry.title: l541402398/dsh-file-uploads
entry.summary: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.

entry.title: Ghost011118/dsh-balance-meter
entry.summary: DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.

entry.title: v587d/dsh-opencode-go-usage
entry.summary: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter
entry.summary: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.

entry.title: fishxcode/dsh-plugin-deepseek-balance
entry.summary: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.

entry.title: Sev7een/ds-api-usage
entry.summary: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.

entry.title: nonewind/dsh-spend
entry.summary: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.

entry.title: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI
entry.summary: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.

entry.title: omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar
entry.summary: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-sticky-disclosure
entry.summary: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.

entry.title: Meredith2328/dsh-sticky-note
entry.summary: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.

entry.title: Luaphes/dsh-web-attention-badge
entry.summary: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
